strings: Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.
Quantity specifying the total number of packages of the entire document (e.g. declaration/consignment).
Details related to goods weight, quantities, and amounts.
Weight of goods including packing but excluding carrier's equipment.
Details related to the party authorized to act on behalf of another party.
Name of a party authorized to act on behalf of another party.
Identification of a party authorized to act on behalf of another party.
International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes
Code specifying the role of a party.
Code specifying the type of address.
Code specifying the name of the country or other geographical entity as specified in ISO 3166 and UN/ECE Rec 3.
Code specifying the name of a country subdivision.
Specification of the postal delivery point such as street and number or post office box.
Identification of the postal zone or address.
Details related to contact information of a department or employee.
Name of a department or employee.
Details related to communication including number and number type.
Code specifying the type of communication address.
Details related to the party undertaking or arranging transport of goods between named points.
Name of the party providing the transport of goods between named points.
Identification of a party providing the transport of goods between named points.
Details related to rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.
Code specifying a monetary unit or currency.
Details related to the movement and the handling of goods shipped together on one or more means of transport between original consignor and final consignee.
Number indicating the position in a sequence.
Code specifying the nature of a transaction associated with a shipment.
Details related to the party to which goods are consigned.
Name of the party to which goods are consigned.
Identification of a party to which goods are consigned.
Details related to the transport between a consignor and a consignee as specified in the transport contract document.
Details related to the means of transport at arrival.
Name to identify the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods at the time of arrival.
Identification of the means of transport at the time of arrival.

Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number
Details related to the means of transport crossing the border of the Customs territory.
Crossing the border transport means name
Name to identify the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.
Transport means crossing the border identifier
Identification of the means of transport used in crossing the border.
Identification of the journey of a means of transport, for example voyage number, flight number, trip number.
Details related to the first arrival location.
Identification of the arrival location. This would be a port for sea, airport for air and border post for land crossing.
UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User code list
Details related to the goods in the context of export.
Identification of the means of transport at the time of departure.
Details related to the location from where the goods were consigned.
Identification of the location in country or country from which the goods were initially despatched to the importing country.
Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignments) are loaded on to the active means of transport.
Name of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.
Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.
Details related to the consignment which corresponds to one transport contract. (Known as consignment by the Transport group).
Identification of the document evidencing a transport contract by reference number.
Details related to transport equipment used for the consignment.
Identification of the equipment (e.g. unit load device by marks, letters, and/or numbers).
Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignment) are unloaded from the active means of transport having been used for their carriage.
Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are unloaded from the means of transport having been used for their carriage.
Date and time of arrival at port or airport with the intent to unload.
Details related to the party which, by contract with a carrier, consigns or sends goods with the carrier, or has them conveyed by him.
Name of the party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering transport.
Identification of  the party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering the transport.
Details related to valuation applying to the shipment.
Amount indicating the total cost of freight, insurance and all other costs and expenses from the foreign exit location to the entry location.
Details related to the person/party who makes or on whose behalf an export declaration is made.

Name of the person who makes, or on whose behalf the export declaration is made, and who is the owner of the goods or has similar right of disposal over them at the time when the declaration is accepted.

Identification of the party who makes, or on whose behalf the export declaration is made, and who is the owner of the goods or has similar rights of disposal over them at the time when the declaration is accepted.
Details related to the goods item as declared to Government Agency.

Amount declared for customs purposes of those goods in a consignment which are subject to the same customs procedure, and have the same tariff/statistical heading, country information and duty regime.
Details related to the properties of the goods.
Description of the nature of a goods item sufficient to identify it for cross-border regulatory purposes such as customs, phytosanitary, statistical or transport.
Details related to additional documents as part of a declaration or as part of a response.
Identification of a document providing additional information.
Code specifying the type of an additional document.
UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list
Details related to the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.
Identification of the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.
Details related to the current and previous government procedure.

UN/EDIFACT code list 7365
For Customs:  User codes, categorized based on the revised Kyoto Convention
Details related to the origin of the goods.

Code specifying the country in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the application of the Customs tariff or quantitative restrictions, or any measure related to trade.
Marks and or numbers on a transport unit or package.
Quantity specifying the number of individual items packaged in such a way that they cannot be divided without first undoing the packing.
Details related to the party who makes - or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes - an import declaration.

Name of the party who makes, or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes, an import declaration. This may include a person who is in possession of the goods or to whom the goods are consigned.

Identification of a party who makes, or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes, an import declaration. This may include a person who has possession of the goods or to whom the goods are consigned.
Details related to the information of a commercial invoice.
Identification of an invoice by reference number.
Details related to the Unique Trader Reference such as Unique Consignment Reference (UCR).
Identification of the unique number assigned to goods being subject to cross border transactions.
Identification of the number assigned by a declarant such as a trader reference or a carrier reference.
